title: fix(nightlight): detach hyprsunset stdio to prevent wrapper hang
head: 5a9357df6aba
workflow: Opus full review, Sol boundary hunter, Opus self-check of the draft, editorial check, batch gates

leads.summary: If #11195 lands alongside this PR, a successful first toggle holds #11195's flock for the life of hyprsunset
leads.location: bin/omarchy-toggle-nightlight:37-39 (combined with #11195's new lock before the launch)
leads.consequence: First start and first temperature change succeed. The background setsid/uwsm-app (default synchronous systemd scope) inherits lock_fd; after the caller exits, later bare toggles fail flock -n and exit 0 without changing temperature or refreshing the shell, until the daemon exits. --status still runs before the lock. Keep the parent's lock while it works, but close lock_fd in the background child before exec; add a first-start-followed-by-second-toggle test.
leads.triage: factual part verified (coordinator/pr-11195.diff: exec {lock_fd} + flock before unchanged setsid line). Lock inheritance by the daemon exists in #11195 independent of this PR's redirect, so it is a #11195 concern, not this PR's. Published only as 'also changes this launch block'.

leads.summary: New redirection hides all first-start launcher and hyprsunset startup errors without signalling failure
leads.consequence: With no running hyprsunset, if uwsm-app fails, no Wayland session exists, or hyprsunset rejects the configuration, the first-start path now discards the launcher/daemon's stdout and stderr. The retry also discards hyprctl errors, and quiet omarchy-shell returns 0, so a caller receives exit 0 and no explanation despite the screen staying unchanged. Previous launch emitted the daemon's startup log/complaint to inherited stdout/stderr. Retain detached caller FDs but route startup diagnostics to a journal or another bounded log, or otherwise report a failed start to the caller.
leads.triage: covered by Opus Q2 with counter-evidence: keybinding (Hyprland exec_cmd) and menu (Quickshell execDetached) already send stdout/stderr to /dev/null; uwsm-app errors still notify-send. Only terminal callers lose output. Not published as a finding; draft states no diagnostics lost for Omarchy entry points.

leads.summary: Open #11475 implements the same launch fix with explicit stdin handling and the missing regression test; the two hunks conflict
leads.consequence: #11475 changes the same original line to `setsid uwsm-app -- hyprsunset </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &`. Git merge-file produces one conflict at line 39 if both merge; choose a single corrected launch. #11475 adds a first-start captured-output fixture that this PR does not have. This PR's omission of an explicit stdin redirect does not by itself imply a live stdin leak: the noninteractive Bash background job had fd 0 at /dev/null in the sandbox run.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (finding 2); corroborated; coordinator re-verified via gh api (coordinator/pr-11475.json, pr-11518 comment). Published.

leads.summary: Existing nightlight test would pass if this PR's sole redirect were removed
leads.consequence: Every toggle test forces pgrep to succeed, so none executes changed line 39, none asserts pipe EOF while a child stays alive, and the original unredirected quattro-tip script passes exactly the same 14 assertions. Add a pgrep-miss fixture, long-lived uwsm-app stand-in and bounded captured-output/EOF assertion; see #11475's proposed fixture.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (repository tests + finding 3); corroborated. Published as Optional test improvement.

leads.summary: The open supervised-service PR #8164 removes this PR's only target hunk
leads.consequence: If #8164 is merged first, its toggle starts a systemd user service instead of a background uwsm-app process, so the redirect line in this PR has no target and requires a manual rebase. Choosing the service version supersedes this fix without bringing back the same pipe leak; choosing the old launch discards the crash-supervision functionality. This is integration work, not a demonstrated regression on the current quattro tip.
leads.triage: verified (coordinator/pr-8164.diff lines 40-42, 110; mergeable_state dirty). Published as one-sentence overlap note.

flags.why: The terminal CLI is a documented Omarchy entry point; there hyprsunset's banner and temperature lines used to print. The draft's next sentence already concedes terminal callers saw output.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** the change fixes the hang reported in #11457. When `hyprsunset` is not yet running, a caller that captures the toggle's output now returns while `hyprsunset` keeps running, and night light is still set to 4000 K. The same one-line fix, plus a regression test, is already open as #11475 (see below).

Sandboxed runs with a long-lived `hyprsunset` stub, launched through the real `uwsm-app` client script (v0.27.0) and a modeled app daemon:

| Caller (first toggle, `hyprsunset` not running) | `quattro` tip | PR head / tip + PR |
|---|---|---|
| `omarchy-toggle-nightlight \| head -c 4194304` | hangs until `hyprsunset` exits | returns in about 0.2 s |
| stdout and stderr captured | hangs | returns |
| stdout captured, stderr to `/dev/null` | hangs | returns |
| OmaSettings `bin/omasettings set nightlight true` (other Omarchy commands stubbed) | hangs | returns in about 0.3 s |
| `hyprsunset` descriptors 0 / 1 / 2 | `/dev/null`, caller's stdout, caller's stderr | `/dev/null` x3 |

**Verified:**
- In every hanging case, stopping only the `hyprsunset` stub released the caller at once, so nothing else in the script (`uwsm-app`, `hyprctl`, `omarchy-shell -q nightlight refresh`) holds the pipes.
- Both redirects are needed. A `>/dev/null`-only variant still hangs callers that capture stderr, and a `2>/dev/null`-only variant hangs callers that capture stdout. stdin needs no redirect: the non-interactive script already gives the background job `/dev/null` on fd 0.
- `/dev/null` matches the existing hyprsunset launches in `bin/omarchy-restart-app` and `shell/plugins/services/nightlight/Service.qml`, and no diagnostics are lost for the keybinding and menu entry points: Hyprland `exec_cmd` and Quickshell `execDetached` already send the toggle's stdout and stderr to `/dev/null`. Before the change, only a terminal (`omarchy toggle nightlight`) or third-party caller saw `hyprsunset` output, and in a terminal it kept printing after the prompt returned.
- The diff applies unchanged to the current `quattro` tip, where the line is still unredirected.

### Same fix already open as #11475

#11475 (opened 2026-09-12) changes the same line to `setsid uwsm-app -- hyprsunset </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &` and adds a first-start regression test to `test/shell.d/nightlight-test.sh`. This PR's commit was earlier opened as #11518 and closed in favor of #11475. The two PRs edit the same line, so only one can merge without a conflict. Behaviorally they are equivalent: #11475's test fails on the `quattro` tip and passes with either PR's toggle. The extra `</dev/null` in #11475 is redundant but harmless. Open PRs #11195 and #8164 also change this launch block (#8164 replaces it with a systemd user service).

**Impact:** maintainers have two PRs for one fix; only #11475 carries a test.

**Suggested change:** reference #11475 in the description so the two can be resolved together, or carry over its regression test if this PR is the one kept.

**Optional test improvement:** the existing `test/shell.d/nightlight-test.sh` passes on the unpatched `quattro` tip because its `pgrep` stub always succeeds (lines 40-43), so the launch branch never runs. A test with a `pgrep` stub that fails and a long-lived `hyprsunset` stub, reading the toggle's stdout and stderr (`2>&1`) to EOF under a timeout, fails on the tip and on both single-redirect variants, and passes on this PR. #11475's test has this shape.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** source review of head `5a9357d` and the current `quattro` tip, plus sandboxed runs with stubbed `pgrep`, `hyprsunset`, `hyprctl`, `systemd-run` and `omarchy-shell`, the real `uwsm-app` client script (v0.27.0) against a modeled app daemon, and OmaSettings' `bin/omasettings` at `72cfe16`. Real `hyprsunset`, uwsm's app daemon, systemd, Hyprland and Quickshell were not run; their behavior was taken from their source. No live desktop session was used.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.

**Opt out:** To stop receiving these reviews, reply to this comment saying so.
